fields.label: Location
fields.note: The listing's jserp-filters form carries hidden keywords/location/geoId inputs; location is pinned to Worldwide for the company-filtered list.

fields.label: Date posted
fields.note: Radio group on the listing face: Past 24 hours (r86400), Past week (r604800), Past month (r2592000).

notes: Chargebee's careers page publishes the LinkedIn company jobs list at /jobs/chargebee-jobs-worldwide?f_C=2277385. The guest listing ships a real GET form (id=jserp-filters) with keywords/location/geoId/f_TPR/f_C, so the parameter names are the portal's own, but a server-side keyword request with browser headers returned HTTP 429, so native querying is not reliable; the adapter collects the unfiltered worldwide list and filters locally.
